content:
Solo's total reading assignment is 4 (Science) + 20 (Social Studies) + 7 (History) + 8 (Geography) = 39 pages. After reading 15 pages on Monday, he has 39 - 15 = 24 pages left. He must finish these remaining pages in 4 days, so his average daily reading will be 24 ÷ 4 = 6 pages.

Answer: 6
